T.title: Speak Up Kindly - Community Builders of Pecan Grove
T.intro: The Town Council hearing is soon. Before it, a grown-up can send a written comment to the helpers who decide. Make a short, kind postcard. Nothing gets sent. You show it to a grown-up.
T.lead: What do you want to say? Make your own postcard about one topic, any one you like.
T.tap: Tap one tile in each row, all about that topic. You can change your mind.
T.from: From: a kid in Pecan Grove
T.who: Who decides your idea? Tap who your card is for.
T.right: Yes! This helper decides your idea.
T.here: Here is who decides your idea.

$parts: of 3 parts. All three parts help people understand you.
topics. A card about one topic is easier to hear.

T.aha: A short card on one topic, sent to the helper who decides it, is easier to hear than a long list.
T.sent: Nothing was sent. Your card stays on this screen.
T.guText: Kids build a three-part comment (I noticed, I wonder, one idea) and pick who decides that topic. The game sends nothing. If you agree with your child's card, you can send it yourself as a letter or written public comment. To learn how written comments are accepted before a public hearing, ask your city or county clerk.
T.can: I can say what I noticed, ask, and share one idea, kindly.
T.tipParts: Next time, fill all three parts: I noticed, I wonder and one idea.
T.tipTopic: Next time, keep all three parts on one topic. One topic is easier to hear.
T.tipWho: Next time, ask: who decides my idea?
T.tip100: Great card! Try a new round with a different topic.
T.real: Print your card and show a grown-up. If they agree, they can send your idea as a letter or written comment before a meeting.

bank.b0058: Decides what can be built, after a public hearing. It can set rules for trucks, lights and old graves.
